hints.title: Tree Bipartite Parity Property
hints.text: In any tree, two nodes are separated by an even distance if and only if they share the same depth parity from an arbitrary root.

hints.title: Tree 2 Parity Complement
hints.text: Adding a bridge between trees adds 1 to distance, allowing you to access the larger parity class of tree 2.

hints.title: Linear Coloring Pass
hints.text: Partition both trees into even and odd depth sets; each node in tree 1 collects its own parity group plus max(even2, odd2).

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maxTargetNodes(self, edges1: list[list[int]], edges2: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
        n, m = len(edges1) + 1, len(edges2) + 1
        
        def get_parity(edges, size):
            adj = [[] for _ in range(size)]
            for u, v in edges:
                adj[u].append(v)
                adj[v].append(u)
            parity = [-1] * size
            parity[0] = 0
            st = [0]
            even_cnt = 1
            while st:
                u = st.pop()
                for v in adj[u]:
                    if parity[v] == -1:
                        parity[v] = parity[u] ^ 1
                        if parity[v] == 0:
                            even_cnt += 1
                        st.append(v)
            return parity, even_cnt
            
        par1, even1 = get_parity(edges1, n)
        par2, even2 = get_parity(edges2, m)
        
        odd1 = n - even1
        odd2 = m - even2
        max_t2 = max(even2, odd2)
        
        return [(even1 if par1[i] == 0 else odd1) + max_t2 for i in range(n)]
```

complexity.notes: Parity bipartitioning of trees reduces all-pairs even-distance counts to a 2-coloring linear scan.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running quadratic shortest path traversals across large trees exceeds time limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n + m) depth array tracking node parity.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that even distance corresponds precisely to depth parity equality in bipartite trees.
